title: Zucchini Pasta with Italian Flair
description: A quick and easy vegetarian pasta dish featuring sautéed zucchini and Italian seasonings.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the zucchini and sauté for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Stir in the Italian seasoning and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet, tossing to combine with the zucchini mixture.
If the pasta seems dry, add a bit of the reserved pasta water.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with parmesan cheese if desired.
